preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers t and w representing the minimum number of edges to add and the number of ways to do so.
The values of t and w must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: t == 0 if any(len(cycle) % 2 == 1 for cycle in cycles) else t > 0
postconditions.description: If there is already an odd-length cycle, t must be 0; otherwise, t must be greater than 0.
